annotations.title: Signet pledge pool — publish the result (organiser)

description: Publish your pool's result as one public JSON object (max 256 KB), after it has locked, exactly once: it can never be rewritten. It MUST carry `verdict_hash` (64 lowercase hex) and `outcomes`: a map of pledge id to `burn` or `release`. Outcomes can then be given only as this map names them. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT>.
